title: Tenant SLO heatmap + adaptive trace routing for Dedicated/Private collectors
creator: Marisol Reyes
description: Deliver a tenant-scoped SLO heatmap and an adaptive trace-routing mechanism for Dedicated and Private (VPC/on-prem) collectors. Goal: make it trivial for platform and customer SREs to spot tenant-level latency/error regressions and automatically increase tracing fidelity for affected tenants without impacting global collector stability.
acceptance_criteria: Heatmap UI shows per-tenant aggregated latency (p50/p95/p99) and error rate over selectable windows (1h, 6h, 24h) and supports sort/filter by model, region, and pool
Adaptive router can change per-tenant sampling rate from low->high using a safe ramp (max 5x) when tenant SLO is breached and can be configured with per-tenant caps
Tracing envelopes from VPC/on-prem collectors include a signed, tenant-scoped header so downstream pipelines can enforce quotas and routing without leaking tenant context
No end-to-end latency increase >2% on ingress path for average traffic when adaptive routing enabled (verified by load tests)
Feature gated behind runtime flag and rolled out to a small set of Dedicated customers in canary before broader enablement
tasks: Design API for tenant SLO definitions and thresholds (PM + SRE review)
Add heatmap backend: time-series aggregator that materializes per-tenant latency/error buckets and exposes query API
Implement adaptive-trace-router service that consumes SLO alert stream and updates per-tenant sampling policy in the collector config
Extend collector to accept signed tenant envelope header and a dynamic sampling config endpoint
Console: build heatmap UI panel and linking behavior to open traces filtered by tenant/model/rollout
Run load and failure injection tests for ingress path with adaptive sampling enabled
Write runbook and customer-facing notes for Dedicated/Private SREs
technical_notes: Sampling control: use token-bucket per-tenant within collector to cap burst amplification; default low sampling = 0.1% and high = 5% (configurable)
Envelope signing: HMAC-SHA256 with tenant key rotated via KMS; collector verifies signature before attaching tenant routing header to internal pipelines
Backpressure: router must be conservative and only raise sampling when backend storage capacity margin >20%; fallback to rate-limit traces if downstream saturated
Privacy: redaction hooks run at edge (collector) to strip PII from trace attributes for private deployments before any envelope leaves customer network
Metrics model: p50/p95/p99 computed per-key by sketching approach (t-digest) and exported as histogram timeseries to avoid high-cardinality blowup
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (dev): internal staging cluster - enable heatmap querying and simulate SLO-triggered sampling (2 weeks)
Phase 1 (canary): select 3 Dedicated customers with small footprint, feature-flag enabled and telemetry retention 7d (3 weeks). Monitor collector CPU/memory, trace ingest rate
Phase 2 (gradual): open to all Dedicated pools and Private customers with explicit opt-in. Provide one-click console toggle for on-prem agents (4 weeks)
Rollback: remove adaptive rules and revert to default sampling if collector pressure or customer complaint detected; runbook documented in incident channel
